title: No sync with Pendiq in background
body:
Hi!

We have one of the last nightly builds and Pendinq pen. Pen set to BT always on.
xDrip and pen syncs only when we open xDrip main window.
Is there any way to change sync procedure? 
Right now xDrip retrive data from pen in 10-15 seconds after opening, can you add another one sync in 10 minutes? Also it may be 30-minutes period of silence after last sync with new data.

comments.body: Does it work with the latest version?
